example.intro: This placeholder describes, in plain terms, how a fictional company called Acme might handle information about visitors to its website and the operators who use its platform. Swap it for your own policy before launch.

blocks.text: Visitors to this marketing site, people who request a demo, and staff at internet providers who sign in to the Acme platform on behalf of their employer.
Only what we need to respond to you and to run the service:

items: Contact details you type into a form, such as your name, work email and company size.
Basic, aggregated site analytics — and only after you accept them in the cookie banner.
Operational data an operator connects to the platform, processed on that operator’s instructions.

blocks.text: To answer demo requests, to keep the site and platform working and secure, and to understand which pages are useful. We do not sell personal information and we do not use subscriber data to train shared models.
Strictly necessary storage is always on so the site can remember your consent choice. Analytics stay off until you opt in, and you can change your mind any time from the Cookies link in the footer.
We share information with vendors that host or support the service under written agreements, when the law requires it, or as part of a merger with notice to you.
We keep information only as long as it is needed for the purposes above, encrypt it in transit and at rest, and limit access to people who need it to do their job.
Depending on where you live, you may ask to see, correct, or delete your information, or object to certain uses. Contact us and we will respond within the time the law allows.
